confirmHint: The plan will be hidden. Your workout records, review statistics and progress records are kept. Undo within 10 seconds, or restore it in Settings within 30 days. After 30 days the plan itself is removed; workout records remain.
trashHint: Restore plans deleted within 30 days. Restored plans appear under Previous plans and do not replace your current plan. After 30 days, the plan itself is removed the next time you open the app. Workout records are always kept.
active: This plan has a workout in progress. Finish that workout before deleting the plan.
activateHint: Your current plan will move to Previous plans. Workout records stay unchanged. Your next workout will use this plan.
activateActive: Finish your current workout before switching plans.
